svg.title: Confluence — refined concept studies
svg.desc: Editable SVG. Schematic form concepts and contours derived from the approved ring model. No embedded raster artwork.

g.text: A paired movement around the centre.
The centre leads; the accents frame it.
The sweeps unite the three-stone composition.
Claws, galleries and supporting ties · schematic.
Rounded contact above; open access below.
